pages.title: Bronze Age
pages.text: $(egyptian)Bronze$() was the metal of choice in ancient Egypt. Craft tools and weapons from bronze ingots for reliable equipment.$(br2)Bronze sits between iron and stone in durability and effectiveness.

pages.title: Crafting Bronze
pages.text: $(l)Bronze Blend$() is created by combining copper and tin. Smelt it to create $(item)Bronze Ingots$().$(br2)$(li)$(item)Bronze Blend$() -> Furnace$(li)= $(item)Bronze Ingot$()

pages.title: Tool Set
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Bronze Sword$(): Standard weapon$(li)$(item)Bronze Pickaxe$(): Mining tool$(li)$(item)Bronze Axe$(): Woodcutting$(li)$(item)Bronze Shovel$(): Digging$(li)$(item)Bronze Hoe$(): Farming

pages.title: Special Weapons
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Bronze Khopesh$(): Curved sword with superior slashing$(li)$(item)Bronze Ceremonial Axe$(): Ornate ritual weapon$(br2)These deal more damage than standard bronze tools.
